visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A male speaker with styled brown hair and a black pleated jacket stands in a dimly lit studio. He speaks directly to the camera with expressive facial movements and frequent hand gestures, emphasizing his points. Behind him, the background contains blurry posters or screen displays, creating a professional content-creator atmosphere. (2) The visual transitions through a series of historical artifacts, including a color photo of an elderly man with glasses, a black-and-white military portrait of a younger man, and close-up shots of hands signing a checkbook and metal handcuffs resting on a table. Yellow cartoon illustrations and stylized text overlays periodically pop onto the screen to illustrate the narrative. (3) The speaker returns to the center frame, holding up a physical book with a prominently orange and white cover titled "李登輝與台灣的國家認同." He points to the book while speaking enthusiastically. The video concludes with a clear call to action displayed through large text overlays and brand logos for "有理文化" on the screen.
visual_base.text_narrative_log: (1) [Logo]: 來源：wiki. [Subtitle]: 你知道原來前總統李登輝. (2) [Subtitle]: 曾經也被特務抓走過嗎？. (3) [Subtitle]: 1960年代留日留美的李登輝是本省菁英的代表人物. (4) [Subtitle]: 靠著農業和經濟的專業嶄露頭角. (5) [Subtitle]: 但也引起了當局的密切關注. (6) [Subtitle]: 不只是上課和出入常常被監視 1969年6月. (7) [Subtitle]: 有天清晨他被門鈴吵醒之後一打開門就看到. (8) [Subtitle]: 4、5個憲兵站在門外要把他帶走. (9) [Subtitle]: 當時他已經做好最壞打算. (10) [Subtitle]: 還先拿出支票本簽好名讓他的家人可以有錢用. (11) [Subtitle]: 當時警總是懷疑他參加過共產黨. (12) [Subtitle]: 每天進行17個小時的疲勞偵訊. (13) [Subtitle]: 甚至還恐嚇他說「要弄死你跟捏死一隻螞蟻一樣簡單」. (14) [Subtitle]: 奇妙的是，這樣反覆進行一個禮拜之後. (15) [Subtitle]: 當局忽然把李登輝放走了. (16) [Subtitle]: 警總人員還意味深長地跟我說. (17) [Subtitle]: 「像你這種人，也只有蔣經國敢用你」. (18) [Subtitle]: 李登輝後來推測這次偵訊很可能是. (19) [Subtitle]: 蔣經國要在重用他之前的「忠誠度測驗」. (20) [Subtitle]: 後來他也一步一步走進了國民黨核心. (21) [Subtitle]: 還當上了國民黨籍台灣總統. (22) [Subtitle]: 多年之後李登輝終止動員戡亂條款. (23) [Subtitle]: 來源: YouTube - 華視新聞CH52. [Subtitle]: 也第一次為228道歉. (24) [Subtitle]: 是出於個人原因還是社會因素讓人有很多討論. (25) [Subtitle]: 如果你想要更多的認識這個歷史人物. (26) [Logo]: 有理文化. [Subtitle]: 歡迎你看看最近「有理文化」出版的這本. (27) [Slogan]: 《李登輝與台灣的國家認同》. (28) [Subtitle]: 深入淺出的剖析李登輝的成長背景. (29) [Subtitle]: 政治生涯和思想轉變真的非常精彩！. (30) [Slogan]: 推薦喜歡歷史的你到資訊欄查看更多！.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) A high-energy male narrator delivers a fast-paced, professional voiceover with clear articulation and high vocal arousal. He is supported by an upbeat acoustic guitar BGM featuring a steady rhythmic strumming pattern at approximately 115 BPM. The mix is studio-clean with a high signal-to-noise ratio, ensuring the speech remains prominent over the melodic background. (2) The audio track is densely populated with post-production sound effects, including sharp "whoosh" transitions, digital "UI clicks," and melodic "dings" that coincide with visual changes. During a more serious section of the storytelling, the narrator's pitch lowers and becomes more somber, accompanied by a brief metallic clinking sound representing handcuffs, before returning to an animated tone. (3) The BGM continues throughout the entire duration, maintaining a positive and engaging major-mode tonality. As the speaker introduces a book, a "pop" sound effect triggers for emphasis. The track ends with a final promotional call to action where the music and voice harmonize to a natural close, exhibiting high production quality and technical clarity.
